KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable pathfinding
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Constrain token dragging on gridless scenes with wall-aware paths and hostile-token collision. A token fits through gaps at least 75% of its footprint by default.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.GapClearance.Name: Default gap clearance
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.GapClearance.Hint: A gap is passable when it is at least this fraction of the token's width. The default 0.75 lets a 5 ft token use a 3.75 ft gap. Set this between 0.1 and 1.0.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.GapClearance.Overr: 0 uses the default gap clearance. A positive value overrides it for this size (for example 0.5 for a gap half the token's width).
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.EnemyPolicy.Name: Enemy collision
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.EnemyPolicy.Hint: Which token dispositions block movement. Friendly tokens never block.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.IncludeHidden.Name: Include hidden enemies
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.IncludeHidden.Hint: Whether hidden and secret hostile tokens block movement. Off by default so unseen tokens do not trap players.
Draw the route distance next to the path preview.
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
KNKR_PATHING.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log drag decisions and planning diagnostics to the browser console.
KNKR_PATHING.Keybindings.Toggle.Name: Toggle pathfinding
KNKR_PATHING.Keybindings.Toggle.Hint: Temporarily enable or disable Knkr03's pathing for this client.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.System: Knkr03's pathing is designed for the D&D 5e system. Wall and enemy collision still work outside it, but the manifest targets dnd5e.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.GriddedScene: Knkr03's pathing only operates in gridless scenes.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.MultiToken: Knkr03's pathing constrains one token at a time; this multi-token drag was left to Foundry.
KNKR_PATHING.Notifications.PlanningFaile: Knkr03's pathing could not calculate a path for this drag. Foundry's normal placement was used.
